title: Work Stages
description: Our approach to work is based on thorough preparation, strict compliance with technical regulations, and close collaboration with clients at every stage.

stage1.title: Consultation
stage1.description: At the first consultation, we clarify the main requirements and specifics of the project, answer the client's questions, and discuss the further work plan.

stage2.title: Analysis and Planning
stage2.description: We determine technical parameters, deadlines, and budget, taking into account industry nuances and local regulations.

stage3.title: Design
stage3.description: We create detailed drawings and 3D models, coordinate specifications, and material delivery schedules.

stage4.title: Production and Welding Works
stage4.description: We use modern technologies (WIG–TIG, MIG–MAG, orbital welding, and others) and certified materials.

stage5.title: Installation and Verification
stage5.description: Experienced teams go to the site, perform installation and commissioning. We conduct tests for tightness, strength, and compliance with technical requirements.

stage6.title: Handover and Service
stage6.description: We prepare necessary documentation (certificates, acceptance reports), provide warranties, and if needed, ensure service maintenance.
